newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-STIELIKE TO MANAGE SPANISH SECOND DIVISION SIDE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STIELIKE TO MANAGE SPANISH SECOND DIVISION SIDE.

text.p: Former German international Uli Stielike will take over as manager of Spanish second division side Almeria until the end of the season.

"I have the intention of using more short balls...and playing more attractive football," said Stielike, who speaks fluent Spanish after his years at Real Madrid. "For me this is a challenge as I really wanted to return to Spain".
Stielike, capped 42 times by Germany, has previously coached the Swiss national side and teams in the German and Swiss leagues.
